meta.disclaimer: Payment acceptance varies by lodge, border post, and season. Figures describe typical tourist corridors — carry backup cash and a second card.
meta.sourceLabel: Central banks, tourism boards, and on-the-ground operator reports

intro: Southern Africa is not card-only. This matrix shows what works where — so you are not stuck at a border, park gate, or rural pump without the right money.
usdNote: USD cash is the regional fallback for visas, ZINARA, carbon tax, and Victoria Falls tourism. Use clean, undamaged bills from a bank — not change from a previous border.

countries.name: South Africa
countries.cards: Widely accepted — Visa/Mastercard in cities, malls, SANParks online, major fuel chains
countries.contactless: Common in Cape Town, Johannesburg, Durban
countries.atm: Reliable in towns; use bank-branch ATMs; notify bank before travel
countries.cashNeeded: Tips, township tours, some rural fuel stops, toll plazas without e-tag
countries.usdAccepted: Rare except some border-adjacent tourist shops
countries.parkFees: SANParks cards online; gate cash/card varies by camp
countries.planningTip: SANRAL e-tag for Gauteng — rental companies can add to contract.

countries.name: Namibia
countries.cards: Windhoek, Swakopmund, Otjiwarongo — less reliable on remote C-roads
countries.atm: Town ATMs OK; none in desert between towns
countries.cashNeeded: Community conservancy fees, remote pumps, small craft markets
countries.parkFees: NWR bookings card online; gate extras often cash
countries.planningTip: ZAR and NAD interchangeable at par — carry both paper notes.

countries.name: Botswana
countries.cards: Maun, Kasane, Gaborone lodges and shops — patchy in deep Delta
countries.atm: Maun and Kasane have ATMs; none inside Delta camps
countries.cashNeeded: Park fees, tips, community camps, some fuel in Kasane/Maun
countries.usdAccepted: Some safari lodges; BWP at borders
countries.parkFees: DWNP fees — cash or card at major gates; confirm before remote tracks
countries.planningTip: Budget Pula cash for Chobe day trips and mobile safari tips.

countries.name: Zambia
countries.cards: Livingstone and Lusaka hotels; unreliable at rural pumps
countries.atm: Lusaka, Livingstone, Mfuwe — carry kwacha and USD
countries.cashNeeded: Road tolls, border fees, KAZA UniVisa USD 50, tips, park gates
countries.usdAccepted: Essential for Victoria Falls corridor and road levies
countries.parkFees: ZAWA — USD or kwacha at major gates
countries.planningTip: Dual wallet: kwacha for daily spend, USD for visas and tourist levies.

countries.name: Zimbabwe
countries.cards: Victoria Falls and Harare hotels; many rural places cash-only
countries.atm: USD dispensing limited — bring cash from SA or Zambia
countries.cashNeeded: ZINARA, carbon tax, border insurance, tips, national park fees
countries.usdAccepted: Primary tourism currency — small clean notes essential
countries.parkFees: Zimparks — USD cash common at gates
countries.planningTip: ZiG for local markets; USD for tourism infrastructure and borders.

countries.name: Mozambique
countries.cards: Maputo, Pemba, Vilanculos lodges; EN1 rural pumps often cash
countries.atm: Cities and large towns; scarce on northern coast
countries.cashNeeded: Border insurance, police fines, small purchases, Ponta track
countries.usdAccepted: Borders and some lodges; metical for daily spend
countries.parkFees: Parque Nacional fees — cash metical or USD at main gates
countries.planningTip: Buy metical after Lebombo — declare amounts over USD 5,000 equivalent.

countries.name: Malawi
countries.cards: Lilongwe, Blantyre, lake lodges — rural pumps cash
countries.cashNeeded: Fuel (shortages), park fees, lake ferry tips
countries.parkFees: Department of National Parks — cash at gate
countries.planningTip: Fuel queues in 2024–25 — budget extra time and MWK cash.

countries.name: Lesotho
countries.atm: Maseru, Hlotse — none on Sani Pass or pony-trek villages
countries.cashNeeded: Highland lodges, pony guides, Sani pub, remote passes
countries.planningTip: Treat as cash country outside Maseru — same notes as SA.

countries.name: Eswatini
countries.cards: Ezulwini, Mbabane, Big Game Parks bookings
countries.atm: Mbabane and Manzini — adequate for short trips
countries.parkFees: Hlane/Mkhaya — card or cash via Big Game Parks
countries.planningTip: No currency exchange needed if you hold rand from SA.
